QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] Signal Flare Necessities
QuestInfo.0: If the others are going to have any hope of finding you, you need to fire off a signal flare to let them know where you are. There's nothing you can use to start a fire, but it's far to dangerous to wander blindly around the area...
QuestInfo.1: If you tie a rope to yourself, you'll be able to find your way back to your starting point. And now that you've got that sorted, you can hunt monsters near the crash site to gather flint and tree branches. The door on your left is as good a place to start as any.
QuestInfo.2: None of the others came back, so you set up a signal flare to guide them. The only trouble is, the flare did no good. It's like the darkness just swallowed up the light. To make matters worse, when one of the soldiers finally did return, he was out of breath and panicky. What is going on?
